Links._comment: PublicBaseUrl is the redirect site's base (e.g. https://shrtlynx.com), used to build the full short URL a QR code encodes. Empty = bare code. A link pinned to a verified custom domain uses that domain instead.

Cors._comment: Exact frontend origins allowed to call the API cross-origin (credentials enabled). Empty = same-origin only.

Jwt._comment: SigningKey is a secret — set a 32+ char value via user-secrets/env (Jwt:SigningKey). The app fails to start on the placeholder. SameSite=None (with Secure) for cross-origin frontends.

Email._comment: Mode: Resend (send all via Resend) | Log (dev: log every email) | Hybrid (Resend for DeliverableDomains, log the rest). Set Mode=Hybrid + DeliverableDomains in appsettings.Development.json/user-secrets to grab magic links for non-deliverable test addresses from the console.

Resend._comment: ApiKey comes from user-secrets (Resend:ApiKey). FromAddress must be a Resend-verified domain in prod; onboarding@resend.dev delivers only to your own account email for local testing.

Sentry._comment: Error tracking, opt-in — unset means exactly today's behavior (no outbound telemetry at all). Dsn is a secret; set it via user-secrets/Railway env (Sentry:Dsn). Get one from sentry.io (free tier).

Axiom._comment: Structured log shipping, opt-in — unset means logs stay console-only, exactly today's behavior. ApiToken is a secret; set both via user-secrets/Railway env (Axiom:ApiToken/Axiom:Dataset). Dataset is the Axiom dataset name to ingest into (axiom.co, free tier).

VisitSink._comment: IpHashPepper is a secret — set it per environment via user-secrets/env (VisitSink:IpHashPepper). Empty = unkeyed hashing (dev only).

Threads._comment: The Threads-specific app ID/secret from developers.facebook.com (App Settings → Basic → 'Threads app ID'/'Threads app secret' — a separate credential pair from the app-level App ID/Secret shown above them on the same page; a future Facebook/Instagram connector would get its own section here instead of reusing this one). AppSecret comes from user-secrets/Railway env (Threads:AppSecret) — never commit it. RedirectUri must exactly match the callback URL registered in Meta's app dashboard — the OAuth authorize/callback endpoints are SocialOAuthController, here in Core (not Admin).

Reddit._comment: Reddit app credentials from reddit.com/prefs/apps — see docs/REDDIT_APP_SETUP.md. RedirectUri must exactly match the app's registered redirect uri — the OAuth authorize/callback endpoints are SocialOAuthController, here in Core (not Admin). AppSecret from user-secrets/Railway env only.

SocialOAuth._comment: Where the Threads/Reddit OAuth flow sends the browser back to after success/failure — the dashboard's social-connections page. Self-hosting with Admin: your Admin instance's own absolute URL, e.g. https://admin.example.com/social (Admin's /social page still handles the ?connected=/?xError= query params it always has). Defaults to a bare relative path, which 404s harmlessly if left unconfigured rather than throwing.
